verdict.rationale: Reader accepts natural-language input in two documented places: the `x-instruction` header, which takes natural-language instructions for ReaderLM-v2 field extraction, and the search endpoint, which takes plain-language queries such as 'When was Jina AI founded?'. Most operation, though, goes through structured headers and parameters (engine, format, presets) rather than natural-language commands. The MCP server evidence covers a separate agent-integration story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's general operation and settings beyond extraction instructions and search queries, plus hands-on or independent corroboration of the x-instruction quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions. Both features work with ReaderLM-v2 to extract specific fields
It searches the web for a given query with `https://s.jina.ai/your+query`.
